fieldValues.title: A red master test stops every group PR in a repository, and the reviewer rejects each for a failure it did not cause
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust master CI went red at 13:37 UTC on 2026-11-04 (merge of #1564, run 41839775989): Test fails on srs-projection rfc_035_parity (bundle envelope vs the reference emitter). Five group PRs (srs-rust#1575, #1574, #1573, #1570, #1562) were then rejected by the reviewer on that red Test, and the 2026-11-05 cycle merged no group PR.
evidence: srs-rust CI run 41839775989 (master, 2026-11-04 13:37 UTC): Test failure
fieldValues.body:
- The reviewer judges each PR against its own head, so a red inherited from master reads as the PR's fault and sends it back to the builder, who cannot fix it in the PR.
- What would have caught it: a check of the last master CI run before review, so PRs red for a master cause wait instead of being rejected.
- Same family as cb59a41b (a rejected group PR has no one to fix it).
